text:
deploy-bot: rollout v2026.03.24-release started. Canary steadywatch probes running in us-west1, eu-west1, apac1. Automated healthchecks show tail latency spikes and ~3% 429s for /generate in us-west1.

rachel.kim: saw it on the dashboard — p99 jumps to 2.1s on small-synth, p50/p95 ok. appears at ~15s after pod start.

tom: which change shipped in this release that could affect warmstart? any prefill/prefetch tweaks?

deploy-bot: changelog: reduced prefill parallelism to limit GPU memory pressure, added early KV prefetch hook. Model variant: redwood-gpt-gen-v4.0.0. Canary traffic: 8% us-west1.

ops_emily: my hypothesis: new prefill hook serializes first-token work causing initial latency which trips steadywatch's short window -> healthcheck marks unhealthy -> proxy 429s due to circuit break.

qa_sam: repro steps for local simulation: ```
ab -n 200 -c 10 -T "application/json" -p payload.json https://us-west1.api.redwood/generate
```

qa_sam: payload.json contains short prompt to exercise warmstart. ran 3x, observed ~6% 429s in first 30s of each run.

rachel.kim: suggestion: reduce canary to 2% in us-west1 and extend steadywatch window from 30s -> 120s to avoid transient gating. If that clears, continue rollout. Alternative: pin us-west1 to previous variant v3.9.8 while we investigate.

tom: prefer pin over widening window — safe and quick. Can we do region-only variant pin without full rollback?

deploy-bot: region-scoped pin supported. Use: `kubectl patch deployment gen-model --type='json' -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/metadata/annotations/model-variant","value":"redwood-gpt-gen-v3.9.8"}]' -n us-west1` (dry-run recommended).

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-03124 - us-west1 generate tail-latency causing 429s. Paging ops_emily.

ops_emily: I'll execute a scoped pin and monitor. executing patch (dry-run OK) then apply.

ops_emily: applied pin to us-west1 pool at 14:07 UTC. Observing metrics for 3m.

qa_sam: running a 2m synthetic at 50rps against us-west1 now (post-pin).

ops_emily: early signs: p99 down from 2.1s -> 220ms, 429s -> 0/600. Good signal.

rachel.kim: ok decision: hold global rollout, keep us-west1 pinned to v3.9.8, update release notes with a mitigation note and add a follow-up action item: revert prefill hook or add phased validation in staging.

tom: creating follow-up ticket: TASK-2026-987 - investigate prefill hook serialization / implement staged warmstart test harness. Assign to infra-runtime.

deploy-bot: Canary hold applied. us-west1 pinned to redwood-gpt-gen-v3.9.8. Notifying release manager.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-03124 updated: mitigated (region pin). Incident will remain open pending postmortem and validation plan.

rachel.kim: note for release owners: do not resume global rollout until TASK-2026-987 shows green on the staged warmstart tests and we have a follow-up canary run with extended steadywatch. :memo:

ops_emily: adding a brief runbook note: when warmstart regressions appear, prefer region pin -> extended smoke window -> revert perf tweak. saved to /runbooks/releases/warmstart-guidance.md

qa_sam: attaching sample logs: `inference-proxy: upstream_start_delay=1.78s, kv_prefetch=0.12s, probe_result=429`

rachel.kim: thanks all — will draft a quick post-deploy blurb for the release channel and mark release as paused. :white_check_mark:
